newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Satair listing fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Satair listing fully subscribed.

text.p: Danish aviation spares distributor Satair's initial offering of 622,200 shares was fully subscribed on the first day of sale, lead manager Aros Securities said on Wednesday.
"Due to significant investor interest it was decided to close the sale of Satair shares today at 16.00 (1400 GMT)," a Satair statement said.
The nominal 20-crown shares, at a minimum rate of 140 crowns each, were to have been offered by tender until May 30.
Satair said that the share price would be announced later. The shares will begin trading on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange next Tuesday. --Ole Mikkelsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
